in_sanskrit.name: Rv
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun, Water, Power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rv एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rv is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravi', meaning 'sun'. It is also associated with water and power. In Hindu mythology, Ravi is the name of the Sun God.
